deferred_source_units.reason: The actual clause concerns no refusal at their death and firmness in scourging. It is not rewritten as painless death or bodily health, and its precise connection remains unsettled.
Injustice coming out as from fat and passing into a disposition of heart are preserved. A familiar eyes-bulging paraphrase would change the evidence, so no match based on it is retained.

The source says injustice spoken against the height, without explicitly naming that height as God or the Most High. The checked Daniel passage explicitly names the Most High; the uncertain identification is not retained as a supported match.
The mouth set toward heaven and tongue passing over earth form a specific spatial image; general arrogant-speech similarities do not establish a particular counterpart for this whole image.
The returning people, their destination here and their full days remain unclear in this clause. No referents or return event are supplied from another text.
The speaker is scourged all day and rebuked in the mornings. The checked Job passage has morning visitation and judgment for rest, not this precise combination, so the proposal remains pending.
The speaker restrains an account because it would break faith with the generation of God's sons. No independently supported counterpart for that precise restraint and obligation is retained.
Entering the sanctuary changes understanding of the sinners' last things. Generic sanctuary or judgment language alone has not established a sufficiently particular independent match.
The heart is set ablaze and kidneys altered in the source wording. An imported embittered-heart rendering would replace the evidence, and no secure counterpart for the actual formulation is retained.
The two questions about heaven and desire from God on earth are preserved without rewriting them as a simple declaration that God is the only desire. A sufficiently precise counterpart is unresolved.
This short unit is the fragment As though into the entrance above. Its attachment to surrounding destruction imagery is retained without manufacturing a full independent proposition or target.

The prohibition of lawlessness and raising a horn is preserved. The checked Hannah warning names boastful speech rather than horn-raising in this particular verse; a broad self-exaltation analogy is insufficient for a retained match.
The directions and desert-mountains fragment is preserved as supplied. Promotion or exaltation is not inserted as an absent noun to create a conventional match.
The heading explicitly says concerning the Assyrian, but does not identify a king, battle or date. The checked Assyrian defeat account remains a proposed occasion with no completion credit.
The actual line combines uncomprehending hearts, sleep and men of wealth finding nothing with their hands. It is not converted into a conventional slain-warriors translation.
The earth fears and grows quiet after judgment is heard from heaven. The checked Habakkuk line commands reverence, not silence; the full proposed correspondence is not established.

The verse says human thought will acknowledge God and the remainder of thought will keep a feast for Him. It is not changed to a familiar human-wrath formulation, and the actual thought-and-feast relation remains unresolved.
Now I have begun and the change of the Most High's right hand are retained. No different translation's anguish or remembrance reading is substituted to resolve the statement.
Ephraim's archers turn back on a day of war. The checked Chronicles family deaths do not state archery or retreat and do not identify this battle.

The source says fire devoured young men and virgins were not mourned. A familiar virgins-not-married rendering would change the text; no secure independent match for the actual two clauses is retained.
The enemies are struck backward and receive perpetual reproach. The checked ark judgment names bodily affliction differently and does not establish this exact backward-striking clause.
The vine shades mountains and covers God's cedars with climbing branches. No location or people represented by each landscape feature is established, and generic vine growth is insufficient.

The woodland pig and solitary wild beast ravage the vine. No particular nation or ruler is identified by these animals, and a general vineyard-destruction parallel does not resolve their specific imagery.

The testimony in Joseph, departure from Egypt and hearing an unknown language retain ambiguous pronoun subjects and occasion. The checked Exodus departure text does not resolve those subjects or identify this observance.
